points.quote: `workbench.desktop.main.ts` imports `./workbench.common.main.js` and then adds the Electron-specific parts
`workbench.web.main.ts` also imports `./workbench.common.main.js`. It then adds the browser implementations
A feature is in the bundle only if some entry file imports it, directly or through another import.
Importing a file runs its `registerSingleton(...)` and registry calls, and that registers the service or feature.
